events.note: Authored for credential-evidence#244 (D3) from the cited provider pages read on 2026-10-05; carrier existence and derivation are provider-documented, the span and value policy are project policy. Not an independent review.

Decided 2026-10-05 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#244. Question: are a placeholder, reference or masked display in the app-id-and-secret form, and an appsecret_proof, treated as not credential values? Options: do not flag them; flag the appsecret_proof as derived from the secret; or leave the case a draft. Decision: do not flag any of these inputs. Reason: the pages document the proof as a hash derived from the secret and the access token and the template as a request layout, not a value; a placeholder carries nothing to protect, so the expectation rests on project policy. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
events.dissent: The pages do not say a derived proof is non-confidential, so a consumer may still treat it as sensitive; nothing here stops it.
events.reversingEvidence: A Meta statement that the proof or the app ID is confidential, or a second maintainer's retro-review that disputes it.
